ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $3.00 voucher to the rider for the unjustified route change (RydeTAXI metered extra distance, ~0.63 km unrecovered because the fare was capped at the quote); remind the driver that a rider's "yes" to a stop does not authorise a self-chosen detour and that the detour must be agreed before leaving the route. Note the driver's low route-dispute history — no account flag.

segment_findings.reason: GPS shows the driver leaving the quoted route at ~21:37:40–21:38:10 and driving west to ~1.4115,103.8037 before turning east (~21:39–21:40) to rejoin at ~1.41152,103.80703 (21:41:10) — the Changi North / Gemala Woods loop. Off-route and on-road. No traffic incident covers the superseded section (RD-4(a) fails); only band 4/5 on SLE/TPE, which cannot exempt (RD-4(b)). The chat shows the driver informing the rider of a petrol stop only at 21:43:35, i.e. after leaving the route, and the stop never occurred — so RD-5 consent does not attach and RD-3(b) gives no exemption for a self-chosen detour location. Counts under RD-1/RD-2.

GPS at ~21:47:40–21:49:40 (1.39599,103.83124 → 1.40084,103.82775 → 1.39764,103.82939) traces a westward loop back toward the airport while the destination (Punggol, 1.4064,103.9021) lies east along the quoted corridor; the route's own geometry is outbound-only there. Off-route, on-road, no incident/band-1-2 corroboration, no rider consent of record for this segment (the only chat exchange post-dates this area and concerns a petrol stop). Counts under RD-1/RD-2; its length is small and the metered-fare attribution is partly absorbed by the estimate cap.

rejected_claims.reason: The claim that the rider 'agreed to a short stop so a small change of route was fine' cannot stand: RD-5 requires the rider's own pre-detour message consenting to the route; the chat shows the driver asked at 21:43:35 only after leaving the route (21:37–21:41), the consent was to a stop only, and the GPS shows the stop never took place.

The rider's memory of 'a long loop' is only partly borne out: the first airport-side loop (~21:37–21:41) is real, but much of the extra ~1.9 km (SLE band 4 / TPE band 5 traffic) is explained and not refundable, and the stop was requested by the driver rather than a rider-requested stop.
